newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC MARKET DULL AHEAD OF ORTHODOX EASTER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC MARKET DULL AHEAD OF ORTHODOX EASTER.

text.p: Volumes and turnover on Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market were on the slide on Friday with investors in pre-holiday mood ahead of Orthodox Easter, traders said.
They said few orders had accumulated for Friday and anticipated a slugish trend for next week with public holidays on Monday and Thursday.
Market volume fell to 2.4 million shares on turnover of around 9.4 billion lei, one billion lei lower than on Thursday, with thin supply pushing most active stocks up, traders said.
The OTC's best performer on Friday was cement maker Casial with over 550,000 shares changing hands. It added 200 lei to close higher at 1,500.
Investors have started to be interested in ball-bearings makers, with Rulmenti Alexandria in focus, brokers said. Rulmenti ended 3,000 lei up from the previous day at 18,500.
Prices of another 143 companies drifted higher, 99 went down and 163 remaines unchanged, traders said.
